Game Overview

Survive Squad puts players into a strategy experience centered on command a squad of unique heroes in Survive Squad's gripping survival challenge. Employ strategic weapon merging, adapt battle strategies, and unlock potent upgrades. Lead your team to triumph over waves of adversaries in a world fraught with danger, harnessing each hero's distinctive abilities to forge an unbeatable alliance.
